task_completion.description: Open the scolv application and select the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake event.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scolv window is visible, showing the event list or the specific event '2024 Noto Peninsula' (or M7.5 event on 2024-01-01) highlighted.

task_completion.description: Access the Picker view to load waveforms for stations GE.GSI, GE.BKB, and GE.SANI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Picker' tab or window is open, showing waveform traces labeled with station codes GSI, BKB, and SANI.

task_completion.description: Manually place or refine P-wave arrival picks for the three specified stations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Vertical markers (usually green or labeled 'P') are placed on the waveform traces for GE.GSI, GE.BKB, and GE.SANI in the Picker window.

task_completion.description: Trigger a relocation of the event based on the new manual picks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Locate' button is pressed, and a new origin/hypocenter solution appears in the 'Location' tab of scolv.

task_completion.description: Ensure the evaluation mode for the new origin is set to 'manual'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Location or Origin details tab, the 'Evaluation' or 'Mode' field is set to 'manual'.

task_completion.description: Commit the updated solution to the SeisComP database.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Commit' button is clicked, or a confirmation dialog for database commit is visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the scolv GUI for picking and relocating rather than just executing SQL commands in a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the scolv waveform picker and location tabs.

integrity.description: The agent zoomed into the waveforms to identify the P-wave onset.
integrity.visual_evidence: Waveform traces are shown at a high enough zoom level to distinguish the arrival time from background noise.

integrity.description: The agent specifically interacted with GE.GSI, GE.BKB, and GE.SANI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The station labels GSI, BKB, and SANI are visible and active in the picker interface.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target event is the 2024 Noto Peninsula Earthquake (M7.5). The agent must use the 'scolv' GUI. Required stations for P-wave picking are GE.GSI, GE.BKB, and GE.SANI. The final origin must have its evaluation mode explicitly set to 'manual' before being committed to the database.
